summary: Tiny triangular yard walled in by commercial buildings, with no visible way in.
reasons: Enclosed by buildings on all sides
No visible entrance from either street
Only a few small bays, cars parked

drivers.seclusion: Very secluded: only commercial buildings within 30 m and no dwellings mapped, but the yard is private and tucked into a block.
drivers.access_and_room: Buildings touch the yard on the west, south and east; no gap or driveway to the street is visible, and three or four cars fill the small yard.
drivers.traffic: Quiet inside; Boundary Street and Browning Street carry traffic outside.
drivers.convention: Private business parking; the surrounding streets have meters, loading zones and bus zone signs.

flags: Low-lying: about 5.5 m elevation, no mapped waterway nearby
Street signs on both sides: loading zones, meters, 1/2P parallel and bus zone
Entrance may be through an undercroft hidden from above
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by the buildings on the west and south; open to the sky at midday.
